items.title: a16z 调研 100 位 CISO：AI 如何改写 2027 年安全议程
items.summary: a16z 发布对 100 名千人员以上企业 CISO 的调研，87% 预期 2027 年安全支出增长，主要受 AI 威胁和自身 AI 部署扩大攻击面驱动。2027 年最受关注的七项安全举措全部与 AI 相关，其中 SOC 自动化获最多首选票，内部 AI agent 安全、SOC 自动化和进攻性安全升幅最大，但 AI SOC 工具生产环境使用率仅 18%。

en.summary: a16z surveyed 100 CISOs at companies with more than 1,000 employees: 87% expect security spending to rise by 2027, driven mainly by AI threats and the expanded attack surface from their own AI deployments. All seven of the most-watched security initiatives for 2027 are AI-related, with SOC automation receiving the most first-choice votes; internal AI agent security, SOC automation and offensive security saw the biggest gains, yet only 18% of AI SOC tools are in production use.
en.reason: a16z’s survey of 100 CISOs at 1,000-plus-employee enterprises finds 87% expect 2027 security spending to rise on AI threats and AI-expanded attack surfaces, with SOC automation the top priority yet only 18% using AI SOC tools in production.

items.title: Anthropic IPO 最大赢家或为 Amazon 而非 VC
items.summary: TechCrunch 根据 Anthropic 的 S-1 分析，VC 持股均不足 5%，而 Amazon 可能是 IPO 最大财务受益方。Amazon 持有 62 亿美元本金可转债、其自估持仓价值 979 亿美元，另投 100 亿美元无投票权优先股，累计投资约 180 亿美元；Anthropic 还承诺未来 10 年在 AWS 至少消费 1100 亿美元。
items.title_original: VCs will make billions on Anthropic’s IPO, but Amazon is set to make much (much) more

items.recommend_reason_zh: 文章通过 massive note conversions 揭示 Amazon 在 Anthropic 的实际持股规模，并指出 VCs 虽将在 Anthropic IPO 中获利数十亿美元，Amazon 的收益却会多得多。

en.summary: TechCrunch, analyzing Anthropic's S-1, found that no VC holds more than 5%, while Amazon may be the biggest financial beneficiary of the IPO. Amazon holds $6.2 billion in principal convertible notes, values its stake at $97.9 billion, and has separately invested $10 billion in non-voting preferred stock, for cumulative investment of about $18 billion; Anthropic has also committed to spending at least $110 billion on AWS over the next 10 years.
en.reason: Amazon’s $18 billion Anthropic investment—including $6.2 billion in convertible notes it values at $97.9 billion and $10 billion in non-voting preferred stock—makes it the IPO’s biggest beneficiary, with Anthropic committed to at least $110 billion in AWS spending.

en.title: Google releases world model Genie 4 with real-time control and native audio
en.summary: Google has released Genie 4, its next-generation world model, with clear gains over Genie 3 in photorealistic detail and physics simulation such as object collisions. Users can control characters or the camera in real time with WASD and dual joysticks, change the weather and add objects mid-session using natural language, and the model also generates synchronized ambient sound and real-time character dialogue.

items.title: Axiom 智能体集群用 24 天完成有限单群分类定理的机器验证
items.summary: 作者称 Verified AI 迎来标志性月份，Axiom 的 AI 智能体集群用 24 天完成数学史上最长证明的验证，将跨越 500 多篇论文的 15,000 页有限单群分类定理（CFSG）转化为 3800 万行以上机器验证代码，并发现已发表记录中的 34 处严重出入。引用内容补充称该形式化证明可能是最大的开源项目之一，图中显示 Axiom CFSG 达 43.0M 行，约每 37 天翻倍。
items.title_original: Verified AI just had its greatest month.
items.title_en: Verified AI just had its greatest month.
items.title_zh: Axiom 智能体集群用 24 天完成有限单群分类定理的机器验证
items.title_bilingual: Axiom 智能体集群用 24 天完成有限单群分类定理的机器验证 / Verified AI just had its greatest month.
items.recommend_reason_zh: 一群 AI agents 核查了史上最长数学证明的每一步，数学家已依赖 Classification of Finite Simple Groups 40多年却无人能独自验完，文章记录 Verified AI 迄今最亮眼的一个月。

en.summary: The author says Verified AI had a landmark month: Axiom's swarm of AI agents verified the longest proof in mathematical history in 24 days, converting the 15,000-page Classification of Finite Simple Groups (CFSG)—spanning more than 500 papers—into over 38 million lines of machine-verified code and finding 34 serious discrepancies in the published record. The quoted material adds that the formal proof may be one of the largest open-source projects; a chart shows Axiom CFSG at 43.0M lines, doubling roughly every 37 days.
en.reason: An Axiom AI agent swarm verified the 15,000-page, 500-plus-paper Classification of Finite Simple Groups in 24 days, turning it into over 38 million lines of machine-checked code and flagging 34 serious discrepancies in the published record.

en.title: AI-Native Organization Implementation Handbook: Illustrated Edition
en.summary: This illustrated handbook for putting an AI-native organization into practice breaks community collaboration into a workable closed loop: first spell out the task, ownership, document version, and authorization boundaries; have AI deliver a small sample first, flagging its sources and gaps; then, after human review, execute, log the results, and update through retrospective. en.title:
Douyin penalizes 507,000 accounts, calls out AI marketing accounts ⚠️

Douyin recently issued a governance notice aimed squarely at marketing accounts that use AI to mass-produce accounts, and one number stands out:

507,000 violating accounts penalized in the past month.

That's right — over the same period it also took down 1.135 million violating videos. Specifically called out: AI digital humans impersonating celebrities' relatives to sell products, AI mimicking celebrity voices to mass-produce quote videos, and mass copying of viral templates.

items.title: 当AI智能体开始24小时炒币，真正赚钱的究竟是AI，还是交易所？ 我最近一直在思考一个问题。 假设未来有100万个AI智能体同时进入加密货币市场，会发生什么？ 它们不需要睡觉。 可以24小时监控比特币价格、研究订单簿、分析新闻、追踪链上资金流，甚至观察其他AI正在买入什么。 有的AI负责追涨。 有的负责套利。 有的专门预测短期价格变化。 还有的模仿那些看起来最成功的交易者。 听起来，整个市场都会变得异常聪明。 但我突然意识到一件事。…

items.title: 以前，我总会时不时的写点东西，感想感悟、生活日常，什么都有。自从AI出现之后，就写得越来越少了。我经常会对发出去的东西产生焦虑，担心自己语言是不是不够华丽，表达是不是有语法错误，照片是不是也不够精美。而交给AI我只需要几句话，就能写出一大段比我自己写的好得多的文章，大不了让它多改几遍，总能找到满意的，毕竟挑刺比创新简单。 最早接触的大模型还是文心一言，算是最早一批出现的生成式语言模型了吧，但已经很少听到文心的消息了，后来 GPT-3.…

en.title:
The AI tech world had a bit of a moment yesterday 💥💥💥

1. Google DeepMind launches Genie 4: the first world model with its own sound
DeepMind announced Genie 4 on October 27, initially opening it as a research preview to invited testers.
en.reason: Google DeepMind announced Genie 4 on October 27 as a research preview for invited testers, a real-time world model that generates walkable simulated environments from keyboard and text input and is the first to natively generate synchronized audio—wind, waves, music and character dialogue—with scenes editable mid-run for about two minutes of coherence.

items.title: Google 昨晚发布 Genie 4，AI 开始从生成世界，走向模拟世界的运行规律！！！ 现在的 AI 已经很会生成图片、视频了。 但 Genie 4 更进一步，你可以直接走进 AI 生成的世界，改变天气、移动镜头、和角色互动，甚至听到实时生成的声音。 目前一次只能维持约 2 分钟的相对连贯交互，离真正的物理世界模拟还有很远。 但我更关注它未来的用途。 机器人可以先在虚拟世界里学习走路、抓取、避障，Agent 可以在模拟环境中反复试…

en.title: Google released Genie 4 last night, marking AI's shift from generating worlds to simulating the laws that govern them.
en.reason: Google's Genie 4 lets users step into generated worlds to change weather, move the camera, interact with characters and hear real-time audio, though coherent interaction lasts only about 2 minutes; the piece focuses on robots learning to walk, grasp and avoid obstacles in simulation.

en.title: Recently came across an unfamiliar model, LFM3 (Liquid Foundation Models) — its Chinese name translates to "liquid foundation model," which reminded me of the Liquid Glass design Apple introduced with iOS 26. It turns out the model originated as a spinout from MIT CSAIL (MIT Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence Laboratory).
en.reason: LFM3, a roughly 2B-parameter model spun out of MIT CSAIL, covers text, vision, audio and Omni while using a non-Transformer liquid neural network architecture aimed at efficiency, on-device use and low latency, and the piece contrasts it with OpenAI and DeepSeek.

en.title:
Douyin penalizes 507,000 accounts, calls out AI marketing accounts ⚠️

Douyin recently issued a governance notice aimed squarely at marketing accounts that use AI to mass-produce accounts, and one number stands out:

507,000 violating accounts penalized in the past month.

That's right — over the same period it also took down 1.135 million violating videos. Specifically called out: AI digital humans impersonating celebrities' relatives to sell products, AI mimicking celebrity voices to mass-produce quote videos, and mass copying of viral templates.

en.title: 🚫 Trump: Wants to formally "ban" the term AI and rename it SI (Superintelligence) across the board.
en.reason: Donald Trump asked The Wall Street Journal on Truth Social to rename AI as SI (Super Intelligence), calling AI “a very bad and inaccurate name” and vowing to ban the term in documents after its “Let AI Be AI” newsletter.

en.title:
The AI tech world had a bit of a moment yesterday 💥💥💥

1. Google DeepMind launches Genie 4: the first world model with its own sound
DeepMind announced Genie 4 on October 27, initially opening it as a research preview to invited testers.
en.reason: Google DeepMind announced Genie 4 on October 27 as a research preview for invited testers, a real-time world model that generates walkable simulated environments from keyboard and text input and is the first to natively generate synchronized audio—wind, waves, music and character dialogue—with scenes editable mid-run for about two minutes of coherence.

en.title: Google released Genie 4 last night, marking AI's shift from generating worlds to simulating the laws that govern them.
en.reason: Google's Genie 4 lets users step into generated worlds to change weather, move the camera, interact with characters and hear real-time audio, though coherent interaction lasts only about 2 minutes; the piece focuses on robots learning to walk, grasp and avoid obstacles in simulation.

en.title: Recently came across an unfamiliar model, LFM3 (Liquid Foundation Models) — its Chinese name translates to "liquid foundation model," which reminded me of the Liquid Glass design Apple introduced with iOS 26. It turns out the model originated as a spinout from MIT CSAIL (MIT Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence Laboratory).
en.reason: LFM3, a roughly 2B-parameter model spun out of MIT CSAIL, covers text, vision, audio and Omni while using a non-Transformer liquid neural network architecture aimed at efficiency, on-device use and low latency, and the piece contrasts it with OpenAI and DeepSeek.
